title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Better to get your job done first than wasting time on chitchat.

title: Talk 1
original: You'd better remember that failing to adapt makes you a useless burden.

title: Talk 2
original: Work, eat, run, repeat. Big fricking whoop. Isn't that how life is for anyone these days?

title: Talk 3
original: My job was to take care of 'troubles' for my employers. Eventually they started to call me Scavenger.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Just like the two sides of a coin, no matter how splendid the face is, the backside is always stained with dirt.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I've adapted to this place really well since I joined? Pfft, rubbish. It's just that I've gotten used to working on the surface.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: That's Provence, isn't it…? The wretched girl who got Infected while rescuing people from a Catastrophe... Look at that massive tail she's got...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You know, Doctor... I hated the idea of working with other people, at first. I figured our methods would clash. But at some point, I came to realize that's not the case.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: If only she were still alive... Now all I can do is carry on alone, carrying her dreams on my back.

title: Idle
original: How can you sleep so soundly when you're defenseless…?

title: Onboard
original: I'm Scavenger. Leave the dirty work to me. Just pay me like my other employers and we'll be good.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: No, it's not enough...

title: Promotion 1
original: This still isn't enough. I need to become stronger...

title: Promotion 2
original: Thanks, Doctor. I feel like I have a reason to fight now.

title: Added to Squad
original: Do I need to quip just 'cause I joined the team?

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Don't you hold me back.

title: Depart
original: Conceal yourselves so the enemy won't find you.

title: Begin Operation
original: Hmph, time for a clean up.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Hurry up.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Are we doing this?

title: Deployment 1
original: Tch.

title: Deployment 2
original: I know what to do.

title: In Battle 1
original: Garbage.

title: In Battle 2
original: Keep writhing in the gutter!

title: In Battle 3
original: There is no turning back for you!

title: In Battle 4
original: You get no sympathy!

title: 4-star Result
original: Gotta say that mission was a special one.

title: 3-star Result
original: Hmph. They have only their own weakness to blame.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Tch, some of them got away. I'm disappointed in you.

title: Operation Failure
original: Dammit! Screwed up again...

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Just give me a dark corner.

title: Tap
original: Argh! Let go of me!

title: Trust Tap
original: What? You want me to dispose of you too?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: New Year's? Tsk, just another day, nothing different. But if you need a reminder, crowded places mean more stupid crap can happen, so don't get too lost in the fun, okay?

title: Greeting
original: You got a job for me?

title: Birthday
original: I did use to take birthdays seriously... but who's out there still counting every year they live these days...? Whatever. If you'd like, I could wish for you to have fun today or something.

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Ugh. Just waiting for you to clear out before I grab some cheese from in there. What? My job's never been anything but cleaning up the filthiest of places. Telling me my name's gonna show up on your honor roll?
